strategies.name: Iterative scale-allreduce loop (baseline)
strategies.desc: Performs 16 dependent all_reduce operations with intermediate scaling by a[r] and division operations on sharded segments. Each all_reduce is a separate dispatch (16 total). Represents the reference pattern with maximum latency exposure but simplest control flow.

strategies.name: Fused scale-buffer preparation vectorized
strategies.desc: Pre-vectorize the scale/divide operations to eliminate per-rank loops, using torch tensor operations (broadcasting, indexing) to prepare scaled buffers before each all_reduce. Reduces dispatch count by fusing all local ops into single tensor kernels between the 16 all_reduces. Trades arithmetic intensity for fewer kernel launches.

strategies.name: Hierarchical two-level reduction tree
strategies.desc: Split the 16 iterations into two phases: first 8 all_reduces accumulate intermediate state, second 8 refine it. Buffer reuse and pre-computed scaling coefficients allow in-place updates. Still 16 all_reduce dispatches but reduces memory bandwidth by ~2x through better cache locality and buffer reuse patterns.

strategies.name: Pipelined overlapped scale-reduce chunks
strategies.desc: Partition the global tensor into independent chunks (e.g., 8 chunks of W*32 elements each), launch all_reduce on chunk i while computing scale operations for chunk i+1. Achieves computation-communication overlap across the 16 iterations. Total dispatches remain 16×chunks but wall-clock time is reduced via async execution.

strategies.name: Reduce-scatter then iterative all-gather
strategies.desc:
Replace the repeating all_reduce pattern with reduce_scatter to distribute partial sums, perform 15 iterations of local scale/accumulate on local shard only, then single all_gather to broadcast final results. Reduces from 16 all_reduce (each 224×256 elements) to 1 reduce_scatter + 1 all_gather, trading algorithmic structure for 87.5% fewer collective operations.
